name: specloop
description: Turns an interview into a roadmap you can build step by step, then runs it. Scaffolds the doc structure (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/product.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/roadmap.md, docs/specs/NNN-name), asks about project type, goal, technologies and tools, recommends skills, captures styles, seeds the roadmap from the answers, and drives a CLI-agnostic task loop generated into the target repo. Works for apps, sites, marketing/content, operations and research projects alike.
